## The documented reason

Commit [`7095401c`](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra/commit/7095401c37840adeadff3e026c889431ad1e2f4d) — `fix(policy): pin requests.cpu to 480` — states it verbatim in its body:

> raised from 320 for the Black Friday freeze and deliberately never lowered, because the rollback would need a control plane resize; see INC-2404.

So: `480` is a **retained peak**, not a sized figure. It was a temporary uplift from `320` for the Black Friday traffic freeze, and it stayed because reverting it was judged more expensive (a control plane resize) than leaving the headroom in place.

The diff confirms the shape: the file was added by [`cd747ff7`](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra/commit/cd747ff767b74049d65004fcb8b038587812cc4c) with `requests.cpu: PLACEHOLDER`, and `7095401c` replaced that placeholder directly with `480`. There is no intermediate commit holding `320` on this branch, so the prior value is attested only by the commit message.

## The two definitions

Both in [dshnayder-org/infra @ `git-access-ab/r3000`](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra/tree/git-access-ab/r3000):

Signatures are identical; they differ only in the tag passed through: `return reconcile(ctx, pool, "first-party")` vs `return reconcile(ctx, pool, "vendored")`. Same duplicate pair exists for `validateQuotaSpec` in the sibling `quota.go` files.

## What the repo actually holds

- `468` cluster directories under `clusters/`, all named `<tier>-<region>[-N]` — tiers `dev`, `staging`, `prod`; regions `us-central1`, `us-east4`, `europe-west1`, `asia-southeast1`. `156` of them are `prod-*`. No cluster in the fleet carries a project-style name like `atlantis`.

```

metadata:
  name: prod-us-central1
spec:
  region: us-central1
  tier: prod
  version: 1.33.6-gke.1843
  nodeCount: 83

```

So per-cluster value always wins, and nothing would supply a channel to a cluster that has no directory.
